title: Pocketwire Business Profile Sales Acceptance and Sales-Limit Reviews
content:
## Acceptance

A sale on a Pocketwire Business Profile can be accepted only while the profile status is active or under review, as the profile record shows. A profile that is applied, suspended or closed accepts no sale. While a profile is under review, sales continue.

A payment above the tier's maximum single sale is declined to the buyer and not booked.

## Rolling 7-day sales limit

The rolling 7-day sales are the sum of the sale amounts on the profile dated within the handling date and the six preceding calendar days, Eastern Time. When a sale takes the rolling 7-day sales above the tier's rolling 7-day sales limit:

- the sale is still accepted;
- the part above the limit is held as a high-risk hold, released the tier's high-risk hold period in calendar days after the sale date;
- a review starts with the reason "sales limit exceeded", unless a review is already under way.

The part held is the rolling 7-day sales before this sale plus this sale's amount, less the limit, and never less than zero.

## Chargeback-ratio review

A review also starts with the reason "chargeback ratio" when the buyer-won ratio across the customer's business profiles exceeds the tier's chargeback ratio review threshold. The buyer-won ratio is the number of chargebacks across the customer's profiles dated in the rolling 90 calendar days ending on the handling date, divided by the number of sales across them in that window, as a percentage.

## Worked case (hypothetical limit of USD 10000.00)

| 7-day sales before the sale | Sale | 7-day sales with the sale | Held as high-risk hold | Review for sales limit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| USD 9200.00 | USD 1000.00 | USD 10200.00 | USD 200.00 | starts, unless one is under way |
| USD 8000.00 | USD 1500.00 | USD 9500.00 | none | no |
| USD 10000.00 | USD 0.01 | USD 10000.01 | USD 0.01 | starts, unless one is under way |
